# gitlab_project_error_tracking_settings (Resource)

The `gitlab_project_error_tracking_settings` resource manages error tracking settings for a GitLab project.

~> When you destroy the resource, you can control whether the original settings are restored. Set `keep_settings_on_destroy` to `true` (default) to leave error tracking as-is. Set it to `false` to restore the settings to their values before this resource was created. The original values are saved in state when you create the resource.

**Upstream API**: [GitLab REST API docs](https://docs.gitlab.com/api/error_tracking/)

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gitlab_project" "example" {
  name = "example"
}

resource "gitlab_project_error_tracking_settings" "example" {
  project    = gitlab_project.example.id
  active     = true
  integrated = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `active` (Boolean) Enable or disable error tracking for the project.
- `project` (String) The ID or URL-encoded path of the project.

### Optional

- `integrated` (Boolean) Enable or disable the integrated error tracking backend. Available in GitLab 14.2 and later.
- `keep_settings_on_destroy` (Boolean) Set to `true` to leave error tracking settings unchanged on destroy. Set to `false` to restore the original settings.

### Read-Only

- `api_url` (String) The API URL to the Sentry project.
- `id` (String) The ID of this Terraform resource. In the format `<project-id>`.
- `project_name` (String) The Sentry project name.
- `sentry_external_url` (String) The external URL to the Sentry project.
